evidence.observation: Tube pressure rises monotonically through growth, 2.98→3.25 Torr (k=20..24), versus a flat ~2.92-2.95 Torr during ramp at identical Ar flow
Flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not from a flow change
Temperature holds 750 °C with heater power ~45%, thermal control nominal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed, so atmosphere/air-ingress cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a leak-up test / Ar-flow step to see whether pressure tracks conductance) to distinguish an exhaust blockage from a seal leak; without the O2 sensor the atmosphere is unverifiable.
